accounting.note: Both executable checks passed, including the sealed-bundle check corrected since the previous attempt. The review of committed-revision reconstruction failed. Regression results were environmentally limited (one pre-existing failure that also occurs at the pre-candidate baseline). Remaining review procedures were not completed and no results are claimed for them.

feedback.requirement: Design Map decision 2 and shared contract: reconstruction uses the existing committed-revision methodology builder and adds no second methodology loader.
feedback.expected: The subject operation obtains the candidate methodology manifest and identity from the existing committed-revision methodology builder.
feedback.observed: The operation reimplements manifest construction in its own module, with its validator set hard-coded empty. For the Harness repository's own methodology at the candidate commit it yields a methodology identity different from the existing builder's, so it cannot reproduce a real trusted identity. It happens to agree only for fixture methodologies that declare no validators.
feedback.safeDiagnostics: Fixture-package and sealed-bundle checks pass. Remedy: call the existing builder (it already accepts a project prefix and an explicit validator-source set) instead of a parallel construction, and keep identity checks against its result.
